properties.displayName: Email Event ASIM filtering parser for Microsoft Defender for Office 365
properties.query:
let parser=(
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
    endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailfromaddress_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailrecipient_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailsubject_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildirection_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildeliverylocation_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventresult:string="*",
    disabled:bool=false,
    pack:bool=false
) {
    EmailEvents
    | where not(disabled)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where array_length(emailfromaddress_has_any) == 0
        or SenderFromAddress has_any (emailfromaddress_has_any)
    | where array_length(emailsubject_has_any) == 0
        or Subject has_any (emailsubject_has_any)
    | where array_length(emailrecipient_has_any) == 0
        or RecipientEmailAddress has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
        or (gettype(column_ifexists("To", dynamic([]))) == "array"
            and column_ifexists("To", dynamic([])) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any))
        or (gettype(column_ifexists("Cc", dynamic([]))) == "array"
            and column_ifexists("Cc", dynamic([])) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any))
    | extend
        _remaining = iff(pack, pack_all(), dynamic({})),
        _to = column_ifexists("To", dynamic([])),
        _cc = column_ifexists("Cc", dynamic([])),
        _bytes = tolong(column_ifexists("EmailSize", long(null))),
        _delivery = tolower(DeliveryAction),
        _destination = tolower(DeliveryLocation)
    | extend SrcIpAddr = case(
        SenderIPv4 !contains "/" and isnotnull(parse_ipv4(SenderIPv4)), SenderIPv4,
        SenderIPv6 !contains "/" and isnotempty(parse_ipv6(SenderIPv6)), SenderIPv6, "")
    // Match literal prefixes without expanding records or recipient arrays.
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or SrcIpAddr matches regex
        strcat(@"(?i)^(?:", replace_string(
            replace_regex(strcat_array(ipaddr_has_any_prefix, "\x1e"),
                @"([\\.^$|?*+(){}\[\]])", @"\\\1"), "\x1e", "|"), ")")
    | extend
        _normalizedDirection = case(EmailDirection =~ "Inbound", "Inbound",
            EmailDirection =~ "Outbound", "Outbound", EmailDirection =~ "Intra-org", "Internal", "Unknown"),
        _normalizedLocation = case(_destination == "inbox/folder", "Inbox",
            _destination == "junk", "Junk", _destination == "quarantine", "Quarantine",
            _destination == "deleted items", "DeletedItems", ""),
        _normalizedResult = case(_delivery == "blocked" or _destination in ("failed", "dropped"), "Failure",
            _delivery in ("delivered", "junked", "replaced"), "Success", "NA")
    | where (array_length(emaildirection_in) == 0 or _normalizedDirection in~ (emaildirection_in))
        and (array_length(emaildeliverylocation_in) == 0 or _normalizedLocation in~ (emaildeliverylocation_in))
        and (eventresult == "*" or _normalizedResult =~ eventresult)
    | extend _authentication = parse_json(AuthenticationDetails)
    | project-rename
        EmailFromAddress = SenderFromAddress,
        EmailFromDomain = SenderFromDomain,
        EmailMailFromAddress = SenderMailFromAddress,
        EmailMailFromDomain = SenderMailFromDomain,
        Dst = RecipientEmailAddress,
        EmailSubject = Subject,
        EventOriginalUid = ReportId,
        EventOriginalResultDetails = EmailAction,
        DvcOriginalAction = DeliveryAction,
        EmailOriginalDeliveryLocation = DeliveryLocation,
        RuleName = EmailActionPolicy,
        ThreatOriginalCategory = ThreatTypes,
        ThreatName = ThreatNames,
        ThreatOriginalConfidence = ConfidenceLevel,
        SrcUserId = SenderObjectId
    | extend
        EventVendor = "Microsoft",
        EventProduct = "Microsoft Defender for Office 365",
        EventSchema = "EmailEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventType = "EmailDelivery",
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
        EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
        Dvc = "Microsoft Defender for Office 365",
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        EmailToRecipients = iff(gettype(_to) == "array", _to, dynamic([])),
        EmailCCRecipients = iff(gettype(_cc) == "array", _cc, dynamic([])),
        EmailSizeBytes = iff(_bytes >= 0, _bytes, long(null)),
        EmailFileCount = iff(AttachmentCount >= 0, AttachmentCount, int(null)),
        EmailUrlCount = iff(UrlCount >= 0, UrlCount, int(null)),
        EmailDirection = _normalizedDirection,
        EmailDeliveryLocation = _normalizedLocation,
        EventResult = _normalizedResult,
        DvcAction = case(_delivery == "blocked" and _destination == "quarantine", "Quarantined",
            _delivery == "blocked", "Blocked", _delivery == "replaced", "Modified",
            _delivery in ("delivered", "junked"), "Delivered", "NA"),
        SrcUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(SrcUserId), "AADID", ""),
        EmailSpfOriginalResult = tostring(_authentication.SPF),
        EmailDkimOriginalResult = tostring(_authentication.DKIM),
        EmailDmarcOriginalResult = tostring(_authentication.DMARC),
        EventMessage = case(isnull(TimeGenerated), "Missing source timestamp",
            isempty(Dst), "Missing source recipient",
            gettype(_to) !in ("array", "null"), "Invalid To container",
            gettype(_cc) !in ("array", "null"), "Invalid Cc container", "")
    | extend
        EventResultDetails = case(ThreatOriginalCategory has "Malware", "MalwareDetected",
            ThreatOriginalCategory has "Phish", "PhishingDetected",
            ThreatOriginalCategory has "Spam" and _delivery == "blocked", "BlockedBySpamFilter",
            EventResult == "Failure", "Other", ""),
        EmailSpfResult = tostring(dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","softfail":"SoftFail",
            "neutral":"Neutral","none":"None","temperror":"TemporaryError","permerror":"PermanentError"})[tolower(EmailSpfOriginalResult)]),
        EmailDkimResult = tostring(dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","none":"None",
            "temperror":"TemporaryError","permerror":"PermanentError"})[tolower(EmailDkimOriginalResult)]),
        EmailDmarcResult = tostring(dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","none":"None",
            "bestguesspass":"BestGuessPass"})[tolower(EmailDmarcOriginalResult)]),
        Src = SrcIpAddr,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        Rule = RuleName,
        AdditionalFields = bag_remove_keys(_remaining, dynamic([
            "TimeGenerated","Type","SenderFromAddress","SenderFromDomain","SenderMailFromAddress",
            "SenderMailFromDomain","RecipientEmailAddress","Subject","ReportId","EmailAction",
            "DeliveryAction","DeliveryLocation","EmailActionPolicy","ThreatTypes","ThreatNames",
            "ConfidenceLevel","SenderObjectId","SenderIPv4","SenderIPv6","EmailDirection",
            "AuthenticationDetails","To","Cc","EmailSize","AttachmentCount","UrlCount","EmailLanguage"]))
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
        EventType, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventResult, EventResultDetails,
        EventOriginalUid, EventOriginalResultDetails, EventMessage,
        Dvc, DvcEntityKey, DvcAction, DvcOriginalAction,
        Dst, Src, SrcIpAddr, IpAddr, SrcUserId, SrcUserIdType,
        EmailFromAddress, EmailFromDomain, EmailMailFromAddress, EmailMailFromDomain,
        EmailSubject, EmailLanguage, EmailToRecipients, EmailCCRecipients,
        EmailSizeBytes, EmailFileCount, EmailUrlCount, EmailDirection,
        EmailDeliveryLocation, EmailOriginalDeliveryLocation,
        EmailSpfOriginalResult, EmailSpfResult, EmailDkimOriginalResult, EmailDkimResult,
        EmailDmarcOriginalResult, EmailDmarcResult, RuleName, Rule,
        ThreatOriginalCategory, ThreatName, ThreatOriginalConfidence, AdditionalFields, AdditionalEntities
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix, emailfromaddress_has_any=emailfromaddress_has_any, emailrecipient_has_any=emailrecipient_has_any, emailsubject_has_any=emailsubject_has_any, emaildirection_in=emaildirection_in, emaildeliverylocation_in=emaildeliverylocation_in, eventresult=eventresult, disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
